definition.description: The percentage of hemoglobin saturated with oxygen (SpO2).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage value of oxygen saturation (SpO2) from the vital signs section of the record. If the value is reported with modifiers such as 'RA' (room air) or a specific flow rate of supplemental oxygen, extract only the numeric percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if oxygen saturation is not documented or if the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: oxygen_saturation

definition.description: Whether the patient is using supplemental oxygen therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract as 'Yes' if the pretreatment record indicates the patient is receiving supplemental oxygen (e.g., 'on oxygen', 'O2 therapy', 'supplemental oxygen'); otherwise 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: oxygen_therapy_use

definition.description: The immunohistochemical expression status of the p40 protein in tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of p40 immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining from the pathology report. Categorize as 'Positive' if the report indicates any form of positivity (e.g., 'Positive', 'Strong nuclear positivity', 'p40+', 'Diffuse nuclear') and 'Negative' if the report indicates negativity (e.g., 'Negative', 'p40-', 'Excludes squamous differentiation').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if p40 immunohistochemistry is not performed or the result is not mentioned in the record.
definition.name: p40_expression

definition.description: The administered dose of paclitaxel per cycle.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the paclitaxel dose from the chemotherapy regimen or administration records, typically reported in mg/m^2.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the dose is not documented or cannot be determined from the record.
definition.name: paclitaxel_dose

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric grade (0-4) for pain severity as reported by the patient using the PRO-CTCAE instrument, where 0 = None, 1 = Mild, 2 = Moderate, 3 = Severe, and 4 = Life-threatening or disabling.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no pain severity grade from the PRO-CTCAE scale is documented.
definition.name: pain_severity

definition.description: Patient's status regarding the receipt or designation of palliative care.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record indicates the patient is receiving palliative care, has a palliative care consultation, or is documented as having a palliative care status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of palliative care status in the record.
definition.name: palliative_care_status

definition.description: Whether the patient has expressed or documented specific medical treatment preferences or advance directives in the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the record contains any mention of advance directives, living wills, DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) orders, DNI (Do Not Intubate) orders, or explicitly stated patient preferences regarding medical care.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no documentation of patient wishes is present in the record, represent as 'Not Documented'.
definition.name: patient_wishes

definition.description: The percentage of viable tumor cells showing membranous and/or cytoplasmic PD-L1 staining, known as the Tumor Proportion Score (TPS).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric percentage value of the PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) from the pathology or oncology record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PD-L1 TPS is not documented, reported as not performed, or listed as pending.
definition.name: pd_l1_tps

definition.description: The numeric dose of pembrolizumab administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the pembrolizumab dose administered per dose cycle from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dose is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: pembrolizumab_dose

definition.description: The grade of peripheral neuropathy, representing the severity of nerve damage often induced by chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade of peripheral neuropathy (e.g., 'Grade 1', '2/4') from the oncology assessment, progress notes, or patient-reported outcome tools such as PRO-CTCAE. If only a descriptive term is provided (e.g., 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe') and mapped to a grade in the same note, extract the numeric grade.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing, not mentioned, or ambiguous grade documentation as null.
definition.name: peripheral_neuropathy_grade

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
